北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴冷，体感 -8℃。注意保暖，别着凉哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is clear but feels like -8℃. Stay warm and don't catch a cold!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪多云有风，体感 -3℃。添衣防风，暖和点！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and windy, feels like -3℃. Dress warmly and stay cozy!
慈溪.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，体感 -2℃。微凉，记得加件衣服哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, feels like -2℃. A bit chilly, remember to add a layer!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，体感 10℃。虽不冷，也别忘添衣！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy, feels like 10℃. Not too cold, but don't forget extra layers!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天微凉，体感 9℃。小心感冒，照顾好自己。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and cool, feels like 9℃. Be careful not to catch a cold, take care!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴冷，体感 -5℃。风力 3级，注意防寒保暖。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and cold, feels like -5℃. With 3rd degree wind, stay warm!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴冷，体感 -5℃。阳光虽好，也要多穿点！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is clear and cold, feels like -5℃. Enjoy the sun, but dress warmly!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 2℃。微凉，外出记得带伞哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels like 2℃. A bit cool, remember an umbrella when out.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴冷，体感 -6℃。低温易感，多穿厚衣服！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and cold, feels like -6℃. Low temps can make you sick, wear thick clothes!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 -4℃。注意防寒，喝杯热水暖暖身。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, feels like -4℃. Stay warm, perhaps a hot drink to warm up.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 3℃。湿度高，湿冷注意保暖。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels like 3℃. High humidity means damp cold, stay warm!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗，体感 -28℃。极寒，务必全副武装！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is clear, feels like -28℃. Extremely cold, make sure to bundle up completely!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -28℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗，体感 -22℃。天寒地冻，注意防冻伤。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is clear, feels like -22℃. Freezing cold, beware of frostbite.
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -22℃ | 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗，体感 9℃。昼夜温差大，早晚添衣。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is clear, feels like 9℃. Large day-night temp difference, add layers in mornings/evenings.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，体感 7℃。海风微凉，记得多穿点。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels like 7℃. Sea breeze is cool, remember to layer up.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感 -12℃。风力 4级，注意防风保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy, feels like -12℃. With 4th degree wind, stay warm and protected from wind!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 -18℃。风大天冷，谨防感冒。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels like -18℃. Windy and cold, beware of catching a cold.
大连.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -18℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级
